changelog: `apm install --frozen` and cold lockfile replays print the package header as `<name> #<ref> @<sha>`, without repeating the locked commit (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: A cold lockfile replay printed the package header with the locked full commit as the ref, so a frozen install showed '<name>#main #<SHA40> @<SHA8>' instead of the install shape '<name> #main @<SHA8>'.

red: APM_BINARY_PATH="$(uv run which apm)" uv run --extra dev pytest tests/integration/test_frozen_replay_output_lifecycle.py::test_cold_frozen_replay_header_matches_install_shape -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider -q -> E At index 0 diff: '  [+] git.example.invalid/acme/plugins-official/plugins/commit-commands#main #17c561a017b5eb2ef7828523aac17a22e848013a @17c561a0' != '  [+] git.example.invalid/acme/plugins-official/plugins/commit-commands #main @17c561a0'
owner: src/apm_cli/install/source_helpers.py (header_ref), consumed by CachedDependencySource and FreshDependencySource in src/apm_cli/install/sources.py
notes: Applies to every cold lockfile replay (plain install with a lock and an empty apm_modules too), not only --frozen: build_download_ref pins the download to the locked commit, so the downloader reported the commit as the ref. Flips J05 s6 known cell frozen-header-repeats-ref (PR #4156).
